recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future substantive methodology changes should be handled in the maintained Guidance IG / IG Publisher documentation or under unresolved methodology trackers such as FHIR-8119, rather than duplicating living guidance in the core FHIR source for FHIR-5475.
issue_request: FHIR-5475 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 ballot comment asking for an example implementation guide and guidelines for how FHIR IGs should be structured; the final resolution was to provide additional best-practice guidance based on CGIT Oct. 2015 guidance and encourage project IGs to follow it.
initial_application: No exact git commit tagged FHIR-5475 was found. Jira comments show the work was deferred past DSTU2 because it required tooling time, and MnM later closed the ticket in 2018 because substantial IG consistency work had been done and continued as an ongoing stream.
additional_context: FHIR-8119 is a same-family CGIT methodology request but remains Resolved - change required, so it was not decided in this default Applied/Published run. FHIR-7050 resolved a related standard-heading request as No Change because it was methodology documentation. Later Published issue FHIR-38715 added Guidance IG links to core pages, with FHIR-I minutes recording the persuasive vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini confirms ImplementationGuide is active in the build, and current ImplementationGuide/profiling source links to the IG Publisher documentation and HL7 Guidance Implementation Guide for best practices around IG creation, tooling, and publication.
